coordinates.note: This site is used as the placement for several Fermilab short-baseline and long-baseline near detectors (DUNE near detector, ICARUS, SBND, MicroBooNE, MiniBooNE, MINOS near detector, NOvA near detector, MINERvA), none of which has its own dedicated site record. `kind` is set to `detector` only because A17/the validator requires that for any site holding a detector placement; the coordinate itself is the OpenStreetMap/Nominatim polygon centroid for the whole ~27 km^2 Fermilab campus, not a surveyed position for any one detector hall. Real effort (LBNF/DUNE's own 'excavations and structures' page, its FAQ, and the Fermilab design reports) did not turn up published lat/lon for the near detector hall itself, only that it sits near Kirk Road and Giese Road on site and 60 m underground. Treat every placement at this site as campus-precision, not detector-hall precision. No coordinate is published on a Fermilab page that could be fetched directly (fnal.gov returned HTTP 403); the LBNF/DUNE site confirms the Batavia, Illinois location only.

name: Fermilab main campus, Batavia, Illinois
notes: Coordinates are shown at campus precision; see coordinates.note. `kind: detector` is a schema requirement (this site hosts several detector placements), not a claim of survey-grade precision for any one hall.

summary.plain: The 27-square-kilometre laboratory site west of Chicago where Fermilab accelerators, the neutrino beamlines and the DUNE near detector are located.
summary.technical: Surface campus in Batavia, Illinois hosting the Fermilab accelerator complex (linac, Booster, Recycler, Main Injector, PIP-II), the NuMI and BNB targets, the LBNF near site and the DUNE near detector hall.
